skill.summary: 机票比价技能，通过浏览器自动化访问飞猪、携程等平台，查询指定日期和航线的航班价格，对比后返回最低价和推荐航班。使用场景：(1) 查询单程/往返机票价格，(2) 多平台比价找最低价，(3) 监控机票价格变化，(4) 规划最优出行方案。需要用户提前在 TOOLS.md 中配置账号密码。

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the flight-price-comparison skill.

- Supports automated flight price comparison across Fliggy, Ctrip, and Qunar.
- Returns lowest prices and recommended flights for specified dates, routes, and platforms.
- Handles one-way/round-trip queries, multi-platform comparison, price monitoring, and optimal travel planning.
- Requires user account/passwords to be configured in TOOLS.md.
- Includes troubleshooting steps, advanced features (price monitoring, flexible dates), and detailed usage guide.
